notes.title: Fixed Bugs and Added New Powerup
notes.content: Fixed Bugs that made the game unplayable. Both difficulties normal and hard should now be alot more fun and playable. Also we added a new powerup the laser for the normal mode. Enjoy!!!!!

notes.title: Level 3 Update; DLC (Level 4 Preview, Story, Ship Selection)
notes.content:
We have just released level 3 Update. It includes new ships, backgrounds, music, and much more. Also we released a trailer for a level 4 which also has new ships, bosses, backgrounds, and music. In addition we are going to package a dlc which will include level 4 with a ton more story to the game and also an option to upgrade your ship by using score points. This dlc will be released in the next month or so. Stay updated by checking back peroidically. If 
you have any questions or comments email us at star.studios.1a@gmail.com. 

Happy gaming!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!

notes.title: Level 2 Update
notes.content: We just released level 2 for Space Wars!!!! It has major updates with new enemy ships, new bosses, and new strategies. As promised we will also be releasing level 3 in a few weeks time as well with huge updates!!!! Keep updated by checking back periodically. Enjoy!!!!!
